  // Declare arrays for lanes
  localparam MAX_LANES = WIDTH/16; // 2 or 4
  logic [31:0] lane_res [0:MAX_LANES-1];
  logic [4:0] lane_flags [0:MAX_LANES-1];
  logic lane_active [0:MAX_LANES-1];

  // Generate lanes
  genvar k;
  generate
    for (k = 0; k < MAX_LANES; k++) begin : gen_lanes
      logic [31:0] a_lane, b_lane, c_lane;
      logic [36:0] lane_out;
      // Extract and compute
      always_comb begin
        // default
        a_lane = 32'b0; b_lane = 32'b0; c_lane = 32'b0;
        if (fmt_i == 2'd0) begin
          if (k*32 < WIDTH) begin
            a_lane = a_i[k*32 +: 32];
            b_lane = b_i[k*32 +: 32];
            c_lane = c_i[k*32 +: 32];
          end
        end else begin
          if (k*16 < WIDTH) begin
            a_lane = {16'b0, a_i[k*16 +: 16]};
            b_lane = {16'b0, b_i[k*16 +: 16]};
            c_lane = {16'b0, c_i[k*16 +: 16]};
          end
        end
      end
      // Active determination
      always_comb begin
        if (fmt_i == 2'd0) begin
          lane_active[k] = vec_i ? (k < WIDTH/32) : (k == 0);
        end else begin
          lane_active[k] = vec_i ? (k < WIDTH/16) : (k == 0);
        end
      end
      // Instantiate function
      assign lane_out = fma_lane(fmt_i, a_lane, b_lane, c_lane, rnd_i);
      assign lane_res[k] = lane_out[31:0];
      assign lane_flags[k] = lane_out[36:32];
    end
  endgenerate

  // Assemble result_o and flags_o
  always_comb begin
    // Default: all ones for unused bits
    result_o = {WIDTH{1'b1}};
    flags_o = 5'b0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_LANES; i = i + 1) begin
      if (lane_active[i]) begin
        if (fmt_i == 2'd0) begin
          // FP32: lane width 32
          result_o[i*32 +: 32] = lane_res[i];
        end else begin
          // 16-bit format: lane width 16
          result_o[i*16 +: 16] = lane_res[i][15:0];

  // Handshake
  assign in_ready_o = out_ready_i;
  assign out_valid_o = in_valid_i;

  // Function definition
  function automatic logic [36:0] fma_lane(
    input logic [1:0] fmt,
    input logic [31:0] a, b, c,
    input logic [2:0] rnd
  );
    // All variables declared here
    logic [31:0] av, bv, cv;
    logic [31:0] res;
    logic [4:0] flags;
    int E, M, B, p, SHIFT_L;
    logic [31:0] exp_all_ones;
    logic sa, sb, sc, sp;
    logic [31:0] ea, eb, ec;
    logic [31:0] fa, fb, fc;
    logic a_nan, b_nan, c_nan, a_snan, b_snan, c_snan, a_qnan, b_qnan, c_qnan;
    logic a_inf, b_inf, c_inf;
    logic a_zero, b_zero, c_zero;
    logic [31:0] sig_a, sig_b, sig_c;
    int scale_a, scale_b, scale_c;
    logic [63:0] sig_p;
    int scale_p;
    logic sign_p, sign_c;
    logic invalid, qnan_present;
    logic [31:0] canonical_nan;
    logic [127:0] L_val, S_val, mag;
    logic signed [128:0] L_signed, S_signed, sum_s;
    logic [127:0] L_sig, S_sig;
    logic L_sign, S_sign;
    int E_max, E_min, d;
    logic [127:0] S_aligned;
    logic sticky;
    logic delta_sign;
    int msb_pos, i;
    int E_lsb, exp_exact, E_min_norm, E_sub_lsb, E_norm_lsb, target_lsb_exp;
    int shift_amt, shift_right;
    logic [127:0] q, r, half, q_rounded;
    logic r_gt_half, r_eq_half, r_lt_half;
    logic exact_gt_half, exact_lt_half, exact_eq_half, exact_nonzero;
    logic inc;
    int exp_unb, exp_field;
    logic [31:0] frac;
    logic overflow, underflow, inexact;
    logic sign_res;
    logic [31:0] result;
    logic [4:0] flags_out;
    int max_exp;
    logic [127:0] mag_ext;
    logic [127:0] q_temp;
    int msb_q;
    int shift_norm;

    // Initialize
    res = 32'b0;
    flags = 5'b0;

    // Set format parameters
    case (fmt)
      2'd0: begin E = 8; M = 23; B = 127; end
      2'd1: begin E = 5; M = 10; B = 15; end
      2'd2: begin E = 8; M = 7; B = 127; end
      default: begin E = 8; M = 23; B = 127; end

    p = M + 1;
    SHIFT_L = 128 - 2*p;
    exp_all_ones = (1 << E) - 1;
    max_exp = (1 << E) - 1;

    // Mask operands based on format
    if (fmt == 2'd0) begin
      av = a; bv = b; cv = c;

      av = {16'b0, a[15:0]};
      bv = {16'b0, b[15:0]};
      cv = {16'b0, c[15:0]};

    sb = bv[E+M];
    eb = (bv >> M) & exp_all_ones;
    fb = bv & ((1 << M) - 1);

    c_snan = c_nan && (fc[M-1] == 0);

    c_qnan = c_nan && (fc[M-1] == 1);

      2'd1: canonical_nan = 32'h00007E00;

      flags = 5'b10000;

    qnan_present = a_qnan || b_qnan || c_qnan;

      res = canonical_nan;
      flags = 5'b0;
      return {flags, res};

    // Infinity cases
    if (a_inf || b_inf || c_inf) begin
      if ((a_inf || b_inf) && !(a_zero || b_zero)) begin
        // product is inf
        if (c_inf) begin
          sign_res = sp; // same sign, opposite handled invalid
        end else begin
          sign_res = sp;
        end
        res = {sign_res, exp_all_ones[E-1:0], {M{1'b0}}};
        flags = 5'b0;
        return {flags, res};

        sign_res = sc;
        res = {sign_res, exp_all_ones[E-1:0], {M{1'b0}}};
        flags = 5'b0;
        return {flags, res};

    // Decode a
    if (ea == 0) begin
      sig_a = fa;
      scale_a = 1 - B - M;

      sig_a = (1 << M) | fa;
      scale_a = ea - B - M;

      sig_b = fb;
      scale_b = 1 - B - M;

      scale_b = eb - B - M;

      scale_c = 1 - B - M;

      scale_c = ec - B - M;

      E_max = scale_p;
